proposed_widenings.name: bond_objects
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's core mechanic is not damage, movement, condition, spell access, or item-form change. It creates a persistent adhesive bond between two objects that survives until a narrow set of named breakers is applied.
proposed_widenings.evidence: This viscous, milky-white substance can form a permanent adhesive bond between any two objects.

proposed_widenings.name: ActivatedAbilityMechanics.range
proposed_widenings.justification: Non-spell activations currently hardcode trace context to Self. Sovereign Glue targets object surfaces being coated, so an honest encoding needs a non-spell targeting/range header such as Touch rather than a misleading self-only application.
proposed_widenings.evidence: One ounce of the glue can cover a 1-foot square surface. Applying an ounce of Sovereign Glue takes a Utilize action...

proposed_widenings.name: UseCountCap.rolled
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's stock is instance-variable rather than fixed. A generic Sovereign Glue record needs to express that found containers begin with a rolled quantity instead of a fixed use cap.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When found, a container contains 1d6 + 1 ounces.

notes: Magic item + activation is the right top-level shell, but no honest encoding exists today. The blocking gap is a missing persistent object-bond effect atom; secondary gaps are non-spell range/targeting for object applications and rolled initial quantity.
